data.body_html:
Looking for a cabopino boat rental no license? You've come to the right place. Chartering a boat without a license in Marbella is straightforward: every one of our boats comes with a licensed skipper, so you don't need any paperwork. Departing from Puerto Banús, just 15 minutes from Cabopino, our fleet offers everything from a quick 2-hour cruise to a full-day adventure. Prices start at just €749 for 2 hours on an Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, including skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and VAT. Read on for the best deals and tips.

Why Choose a No-License Boat Rental in Cabopino?

Cabopino is a charming coastal area with a small marina and beautiful sandy beaches. Renting a boat without a license means you can enjoy the Costa del Sol's coastline without the hassle of exams or permits. With a professional skipper at the helm, you can focus on swimming, sunbathing, and sightseeing. Our charters include everything you need—just turn up and relax. Plus, departing from Puerto Banús gives you access to a wide range of boats, from speedy open boats to luxury yachts.

Our Fleet for No-License Boat Rentals

We offer a variety of boats suitable for groups of 5 to 12 passengers. Here are the most popular options for a cabopino boat rental no license:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) – €749/2h, perfect for a small group.
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – €749/2h, spacious and comfortable.
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – €4,719 minimum 4h, includes free jet ski.
  • Bandido (11.5m, 8 pax) – pricing on request, ideal for a sporty outing.
  • Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) – pricing on request, great for a quick coastal dash.

All boats depart from Puerto Banús and include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT.

Best Deals for Cabopino Boat Rental No License

Our Tier A boats offer the best value: the Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 both start at €749 for 2 hours. For a longer trip, the 8-hour rate is €2,299, giving you ample time to cruise to Cabopino, anchor at Cala del Faro, or even head to Estepona. If you want a premium experience, the Mangusta 80 (Tier B) includes a free jet ski for 4-hour bookings at €4,719. For larger groups or custom requirements, contact us via WhatsApp for a personalised quote.

What to Expect on Your No-License Boat Trip

Your charter includes a licensed skipper who knows the local waters. You'll depart from Puerto Banús, pass the Golden Mile, and reach Cabopino's calm waters in about 15 minutes. Along the way, you can spot the Sierra Blanca mountains and La Concha peak. Onboard, enjoy complimentary drinks (beer, wine, cava, soft drinks) and light snacks. Feel free to bring your own food. The skipper can anchor at Cabopino beach or nearby coves like Cala Cortés for swimming.

Tips for a Great No-License Boat Rental Experience

  • Book early: Summer slots fill fast, especially for weekends.
  • Check the weather: The Costa del Sol enjoys 300+ sunny days a year, but sea conditions can vary. We'll advise if needed.
  • Bring sunscreen and towels: The Mediterranean sun is strong, even in spring.
  • Plan your route: Cabopino is just the start—consider a trip to Sotogrande or Marbella Marina.
  • Ask about jet skis: Tier B boats include a free jet ski; others can be arranged on request.

How to Book Your Cabopino Boat Rental No License

Booking is easy. Visit our Boat Rental Marbella page to browse the fleet, then contact us via WhatsApp for availability and pricing. We accept bookings for any duration, from 2 hours to a full day. For Tier A boats, you can book directly online; for others, we'll provide a custom quote. All bookings include a licensed skipper, so no license is needed. Start your adventure today.
